title: Agent-generated sealed route: RC-T143-CBP-01
statement: Candidate lemma: for every real unit-diagonal SPD A with mu=lambda_min(A), setting L=ceil(16/mu) gives the uniform block-power inequality (L_A^*)^L(A) <= (1/2)A in Loewner order; equivalently, tr(A L_A^L(X)) <= (1/2)tr(A X) for every X positive semidefinite.

signature.representation: Use the epoch-boundary covariance superoperator L_A(X)=(1/n!) sum_pi T_pi X T_pi^T, equivalently K_A=(1/n!) sum_pi(T_pi tensor T_pi) on vec(X), together with its adjoint L_A^*(H)=(1/n!) sum_pi T_pi^T H T_pi. Fresh independent epochs give X_k=L_A^k(x_0 x_0^T), and E||x_k||_A^2=tr(A X_k)=x_0^T (L_A^*)^k(A) x_0.
signature.state_or_invariant: Retain the full positive-semidefinite epoch-boundary covariance X_k and the dual block observable H_j=(L_A^*)^j(A). Positivity is preserved, and H_{j+1} is Loewner-bounded by H_j because every coordinate update is an A-orthogonal projection and hence every epoch map is A-nonexpansive.
signature.core_candidate_lemma: Candidate lemma: for every real unit-diagonal SPD A with mu=lambda_min(A), setting L=ceil(16/mu) gives the uniform block-power inequality (L_A^*)^L(A) <= (1/2)A in Loewner order; equivalently, tr(A L_A^L(X)) <= (1/2)tr(A X) for every X positive semidefinite.
information_retained: A and its minimum eigenvalue mu
the exact uniform distribution over epoch permutations
the dual A-energy observable under block powers
information_discarded: external literature and inherited RPCD derivations
signature.target_implication: Assuming the candidate lemma, write k=qL+r with 0<=r<L. Positivity and within-block A-nonexpansiveness give E||x_k||_A^2 <= 2^{-q}||x_0||_A^2. Jensen then gives E||x_k||_A <= 2^{-q/2}||x_0||_A. Since mu<=1 and L=ceil(16/mu)<=17/mu, this implies E||x_k||_A <= sqrt(2) exp(-(log 2)mu k/34)||x_0||_A, so the target holds with C=sqrt(2) and c=(log 2)/34.
signature.known_failure_mode: The most likely failure is that this second-moment assertion is strictly stronger than the desired first-moment bound: a dimension-dependent covariance direction, sustained by rare poorly contracting permutation products, may make the worst-case block energy remain above one half for 16/mu epochs even when E||x_k||_A still contracts at the target scale.
signature.verifier_class: Agent-declared first falsifier: Later, without approximation, test the candidate lemma on A_n=(1/n)I+(1-1/n)11^T, for which mu=1/n and L=16n. Permutation symmetry forces H_j=(L_{A_n}^*)^j(A_n) to have the form alpha_j I+beta_j 11^T, so L_{A_n}^* restricted to this two-dimensional space can be derived as an exact rational 2-by-2 recurrence and raised to the 16n-th power by exact arithmetic. The first implication edge is rejected if either alpha_{16n}>(1/2n) or alpha_{16n}+n beta_{16n}>(1/2)(n-1+1/n) for any n.
